description.value: Uni Modern Japanese is a Japanese restaurant on Victoria's Wharf Street, near the Inner Harbour waterfront. The restaurant offers dine-in and online ordering with pickup, making it a convenient stop along the harbour cycling corridor. A welcoming spot for cyclists looking for a Japanese meal in the heart of downtown Victoria.
